title: Lucky Man
desc: An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.

title: Ramleela-Govindudu Andariva
desc: Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.

title: Kuselan
desc: Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.

title: Sigaram Thodu
desc: The son of a brave yet impaired policeman, Murali, dreams of a secure future in banking. However, unforeseen circumstances lead him to follow his father's footsteps in law enforcement.

title: Bruce Lee 2 the Fighter
desc: Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.

title: Vinaya Vidheya Rama
desc: Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.

title: Uyirullavarai Kaadhal
desc: Anu and Sanju develop a great bond after the latter arrives in Hyderabad and moves in with Anu and her father. However, they realise their love for each other when Anu is set to marry another man.

title: Judwaa 2
desc: Raja and Prem, twins separated at birth but connected through reflexes, join forces as adults to take down an underground smuggling kingpin who threatens to destroy their family.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kaatrin Mozhi
desc: A housewife content with her life still sometimes dreams of independence. Later, her wishes come true when an unexpected opportunity to become a radio jockey arises.
